text:
josh_support: FYI — just got a support ticket from Satori Labs. Trial org shows 'activation complete' but no seats provisioned. Customer says >50% of team blocked. Need CS handoff + enablement ASAP. ticket# 7890123

tara_csm: Thanks Josh. Can you paste the ticket link + any error logs? @maria_cs we'll need a short comms plan and renewal-watch if this drags.

josh_support: Link: https://support.redwood.ai/t/7890123
Logs:
```
ERROR provisioning: no seat assignment for org_id=org_72
retry_count=3
HTTP 403 on seat_create
```

maria_cs: Looping in @ryan_success for a quick enablement session. Ryan — can you do a 30m call today? Customer is PST. :alarm_clock:

ryan_success: I can join at 15:00 PST. Need an admin email or one-time invite to apply temp seats. I'll prepare a tiny runbook to speed things up.

tara_csm: Also setting expectation: if activation not done within 72h this becomes a renewal risk flag. Drafting comms: "we're prioritizing your activation; offering live enablement + provisional seats."

maria_cs: Proposed comms copy (short):
```
Hi Olivia / Satori team,
We're sorry you're blocked. We're prioritizing your activation and can run a live enablement session today at 3pm PST. Temporary seats will be applied to get you started.
What to expect: 30m screenshare + seat provisioning.
Next step: confirm admin email for provisioning.
```
cc: @josh_support

josh_support: Customer confirmed admin: olivia@slabs.com. Also flagged quota-service 403 on seat_create, maybe policy/tenant issue. I will open infra ticket if needed.

ryan_success: Thanks — I'll run the session and apply temporary seats as a workaround. @oncall-bot please notify infra if rollback or quota patch required.
Session notes template I'll use:
- start: check org status + audit logs
- apply temp seats (provisional role)
- verify login for 3 users
- hand off post-session next steps

oncall-bot: infra-alert: quota-service returned 403 for org_72 at 2025-04-02T22:45Z. Paging eng-infra.

ken_ops: (eng-infra) Investigating quota-service. Found policy misassignment on tenant. Patch ETA ~45m. Will update here when fixed.

tara_csm: OK — CS playbook: if infra fix >30m we perform temp seats + document workaround in ticket and send the comms above. Mark renewal-watch and schedule 24h follow-up.

maria_cs: Assigning tasks:
- josh_support: own ticket & keep customer updates
- ryan_success: run enablement + upload session notes/recording
- tara_csm: comms + renewal-watch flag
- ken_ops: infra fix
I'll update customer at 13:45 PST. :white_check_mark:

josh_support: Ack. Ticket updated with triage steps and 3pm session invite. Notified customer.

ryan_success: Will post session recording + step-by-step in the ticket. Also recommend a D+7 automated drip: enablement follow-up + short health survey.

maria_cs: Agreed — after infra fix we schedule a 1-week health check and note this as a potential upsell/retention risk in the account record. Thanks team.
